title: Tech at RBC Wealth Management – Minneapolis
description: We're on a mission to create new and exciting futures for our clients and communities. Join us – jobs.rbc.com/wmtech.

asr.full_text: One of the greatest things about RBC is the culture. The level of collaboration we have has given my team members a lot of opportunity and it's really rewarding. It's really, really a great organization to be part of. We're at a crossroads in the industry where we can really redefine what it means to be part of wealth management and what it means to serve clients in a new way. And that's that's really why I joined RBC. Other technologists should work at RBC in technology because we're out there to disrupt technology within banking and outside of banking. So one of the neat aspects of working for RBC is the fact that it very much feels like you're part of a small team, but yet you have the resources of an entire global bank, one of the largest banks an entire global bank at your disposal. Here I don't feel like I'm just a number. Like employee number three thousand. The cultural difference is big! If I had to describe what is like to work at IRBC in three words, I would probably say collaborative, exciting, fun. With three words, I would probably say collaborative, exciting, fun. We have leaders here who come from technology backgrounds and leaders who recognize that banking and financial services is going to be redefined by technology. So if you're excited about applying technology in a new way, in an industry that's groundbreaking, that's innovative that it's gonna make a large amount of impact across the world going forward. That's where I believe RBC is a very attractive place to be part of.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents RBC technology and wealth-management work as a recruitment topic, with speakers discussing collaboration and opportunities for technologists. Its audience action is to visit a jobs webpage, which is consistent with employment promotion rather than a request for investment, payment, credentials, or financial participation. The visual material depicts office settings and an RBC-branded recruitment endpoint.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Technology and business operations are central to the employment-promotion content: the speaker discusses applying technology within banking and wealth management, while the video invites technologists to work at RBC.
